summary: This is a bash test that checks whether a phpunit.xml configuration file exists and has content. If the file doesn't exist or is empty, it prints an error message and stops the script with an exit code of 1 to signal failure.

explanations.1: The -s flag tests whether the file exists AND has a size greater than zero (isn't empty). The || means 'if that test fails, then do what comes next'. The curly braces group multiple commands together: echo prints the error message, and exit 1 stops the script and tells the system something went wrong.
